metadata.title: A Crack Smaller Than a Coin Dropped a Whole Bridge
metadata.description:
Silver Bridge fell into the Ohio River at rush hour. The cause: stress corrosion cracking in an eyebar of a non-redundant chain.

Failure chain: Defect in one eyebar → Stress corrosion grows the crack → Eyebar fractures → Chain has no backup → Whole Bridge falls

Related episode: The Undersized Steel Plate That Dropped a Freeway — https://youtu.be/8eb8nuVkMrE

Series — Bridge Failures: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSvgXCp-nMqY

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Silver Bridge — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silver_Bridge
• NTSB Highway Accident Report HAR-71-01 — Collapse of U.S. 35 Highway Bridge, Point Pleasant — https://www.ntsb.gov/investigations/AccidentReports/Reports/HAR7101.pdf

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
